evidence_sentence: It then verifies that the block number is within valid filesystem bounds.
rationale: The fixed implementation alone computes the filesystem end-of-range value and returns NULL when blkno is out of bounds. The vulnerable implementation performs no filesystem-bounds validation before deriving the allocation group and searching the cache tree. This sentence therefore directly specifies the added fix-only guard.
rewritten_docstring: The function first calculates the total number of bytes to be searched and checks for alignment. It then searches the buffer cache using the requested block mapping. If a matching buffer is found, it checks if it is stale and attempts to lock it. If no match is found, it may insert a new buffer into the tree. The function handles locking and reference counting appropriately to ensure thread safety and proper resource management.
